subject: Expansion: NovaCorp — onboarding 3 new apps, API keys, and renewal addendum
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@novacorp.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion planning follow-up

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have approval to onboard three additional internal apps onto Redwood (Search, Summaries, and Compliance-tagging). Before we lock dates, Procurement asked for a single-page summary of the scope, a list of new API keys, and the cost impact for year 2 (we're approaching renewal). Can you pull that together?

Elena
Director of Product
NovaCorp

---

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion planning follow-up

Elena —

Great news, congrats on the thumbs-up. Drafting the requested materials now. Quick answers up front:
- We can provision separate API keys for each app (3 keys) and also create scoped keys per environment (prod/stage) if you want isolation.
- If you increase committed capacity as part of renewal, unit pricing drops and we can reserve burst capacity for Summaries (higher token usage).
- I attached a short addendum outlining the term change that converts part of your overage spend into a committed capacity block and the updated quote (quote-NC-EXP-2026.pdf). Also included a suggested rollout schedule (nova-rollout-staggered.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) Camila to confirm rollout sequencing and staging windows (low-latency zone selection).
2) Procurement to confirm if they want the addendum signed with the renewal or as an amendment now.
3) We provision dev/stage keys immediately once procurement signals 'go'.

I put a target timeline in the sheet for a staggered onboarding (Search -> Summaries -> Compliance-tagging) across two sprints to minimize spike risk.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood-addendum-novacorp-20260830.pdf, nova-rollout-staggered.xlsx, quote-NC-EXP-2026.pdf

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion planning follow-up

Elena, Marcus —

Quick technical notes on the proposed staging in the XLS:
- Recommend turning on per-project KV caching for Search to avoid repeated context recomputation during heavy query patterns.
- Summaries will benefit from a higher token budget; plan the Summaries rollout into a dedicated pool or pin to a higher throughput instance for week 1.
- Compliance-tagging: we suggest a short validation window (5 days) on 10% of Production traffic before full flip. We can automate the split with our routing policy (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

I'll add a one-page runbook to the rollout workbook with the verification checks and expected token consumption per stage.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@novacorp.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion planning follow-up

Elena —

From a CS/timeline standpoint: we can support onboarding across the three apps in a 3-week window if NovaCorp assigns one engineering owner per app and grants access to the staging clusters. Proposed schedule in the sheet is:
- Week 1: Provision keys & integrate Search (dev -> stage -> prod validation)
- Week 2: Summaries integration + load verification
- Week 3: Compliance-tagging validation and full rollout

We can also provide a dedicated surge of support during the Summaries rollout (engineering triage hours included in the addendum). If Procurement needs a legal review, loop in your counsel and we can have Legal expedite the addendum review.

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks — that looks reasonable. A few clarifications from Procurement:
- They want the addendum to be effective immediately (so charges start from the signature date) but aligned with our renewal window (so the term runs through our renewal anniversary). Is that possible?
- They also asked for a CSV list of the new API key IDs and their intended app names; can you generate that once keys are provisioned?

Procurement requested a single combined PDF with: addendum, updated quote, and the rollout plan (can you produce and send as one file?). Also please send the DocuSign link to the person handling signature (I will be signing on NovaCorp side).

Elena
